answer: In an agent market for yarrow deliveries across an island, each depot is a vertex on the dispatch map. To qualify for subsidized jobs, each bidder must pass an unannounced pickup drill. Assign drills to separate depots with deadlines that overlap too closely for one driver to meet both. Depot staff sign a receipt for each completed drill. To qualify more aliases, an attacker must pay more drivers to stand by for drills that may yield no work.
